_doc: UPDATE 12 section 4 (T-210): every in-engine cutscene shot a performer can be filmed for. One file per shot per role: assets/user_supplied/mocap/<scene>/<shot>_<role>.fbx (or .bvh). tools/mocap.sh report lists what is missing, tools/mocap.sh build turns what is there into assets/ours/mocap/<scene>/mocap_<scene>.res, tools/mocap.sh guide writes docs/MOCAP_GUIDE.md's shot tables from this file. A role is a character id (dutch, peg, deacon, wren, jakub, selwyn, copilot) or a seat / slot (seat1..seat4: the C-47 passengers, window first; slot1..slot4: the squad's places in the group, front first) or 'any' (one take for everyone without their own). At run time a stand-in looks for its character, then its seat / slot, then any; with none it keeps the stand-in animation. 'dur' is the shot's length in seconds (test_mocap checks it against the cutscene data); 'lines' are [seconds into the shot, line id, who]; 'root' is 'mocap' (the take's own walking moves the body: walk where the marks say) or 'cast' (the game moves the body along the stand-in's path; the take's steps play in place, looped if short); 'priority' high = the camera is close on people, optional = they are small in frame.

roles.seat1: C-47 passenger, window seat (whoever plays first)

scenes.title: GRAVELIGHT ONE: the crash (Map 0, before the inn opening)
scenes.set_up: Four chairs 45 cm high in a row, 1.05 m apart, all facing the phone (the C-47's port-wall bucket seats; seat 1 is the window seat, on your left as you sit). For the cockpit: two chairs side by side 0.9 m apart, a broom handle held upright between your knees as the control column, a dinner plate held flat as the yoke.

shots.camera: 3.5 m in front of the chair, phone at seated chest height (0.9 m).
shots.marks: The chair on the X. Feet flat, a bag between your boots.

action.seat1: Sit strapped in, hands on your knees, look across the cabin (at the phone). Shift once as the plane rattles at 2.5 s.
action.seat2: Sit, arms folded, look at the floor, then up at the roof as the pilot talks (1 s).
action.seat3: Sit, hands clasped between your knees; tap one boot slowly.
action.seat4: Asleep, or pretending: head down on your chest, arms folded. Don't move except breathing.

shots.props: A bag or backpack between your feet.

shots.camera: 2.5 m behind your right shoulder, 1.2 m high (the camera looks past you at the window).
shots.marks: The chair on the X. The window is to your left and a little behind you: a sheet of paper taped to the wall 1.3 m up.

action.seat1: At 0.5 s turn in the seat to your left, lean toward the window, and look down through it at the ground far below. Stay turned and leaning; at 1.5 s and 5 s something flashes below: lean a little closer.

shots.props: Paper on the wall as the window.

shots.camera: 1.5 m from the window paper, 1.4 m high, looking back at your face past the window.
shots.marks: As shot 3: turned to the window, leaning.

action.seat1: Still at the window. At 0.6 s say your GL1_01 line, shouting over the engines, pointing down through the window once. At 0.8 s a flare lights the cabin white: squint. Stay leaning in.

shots.props: Paper on the wall as the window.
lines: seat1 (the window seat: DUT, PEG, DEA or WRN)

shots.camera: 2 m behind the two cockpit chairs, 1.6 m high, looking over your shoulders.
shots.marks: Selwyn the left chair, the co-pilot the right, 0.9 m apart.

action.selwyn: Fly: both hands on the yoke (the plate), small corrections. At 4.0 s lift your right hand to your throat (the intercom) and say the line, looking ahead and a little right.
action.copilot: Hands on your yoke; at 4 s turn your head to look where Selwyn looks (ahead right), then back.

shots.props: A broom handle and a plate each.

shots.camera: 2.5 m in front of the chairs, 1.3 m high.
shots.marks: Chairs on their X's as shot 2.

action.seat1: A violet light comes in across the cabin: turn your face toward it (the phone). At 2 s check your wristwatch, tap it, hold it to your ear.
action.seat2: At 0.8 s say your GL1_02 line to the person on your right (seat 3), turning to them; on 'hand' or 'count' reach toward them.
action.seat3: Look at the violet light; at 1.5 s take seat 2's hand or grip the chair frame with both hands.
action.seat4: Wake up: lift your head at 0.5 s, look at the light, grip the chair.

shots.camera: 1.5 m to Selwyn's left, 1.3 m high, close on the hands and the panel.
shots.marks: Cockpit chairs as shot 5.

action.selwyn: The engines die. Say the line from 0.4 s while your hands work: pull both throttles back (left hand to a box at knee height), flick three switches over your head, then both hands back on the yoke, holding it against a pull. A jolt at 1.5 s.
action.copilot: Grab the yoke too at 1.5 s (the jolt), brace, look at Selwyn.

shots.props: Broom handle, plate, a shoebox at knee height as the throttles.

shots.camera: On the floor 2 m in front of the chairs, looking up.
shots.marks: Chairs on their X's.

action.seat1: Brace: head down to your knees, hands gripping the chair edge. At 3.8 s and 4.4 s you are thrown forward and back (two big jolts), at 5.0 s a smaller one.
action.seat2: Brace, arms over your head. Same jolts at 3.8, 4.4, 5.0 s.
action.seat3: Brace, one hand on the chair frame, one over your head. Same jolts.
action.seat4: Brace, hands on the back of your neck. Same jolts.

shots.props: None. Don't actually fall; the jolts are a rock in the seat.

scenes.title: Leaving the Crossroads Inn for Kaltenbrunn (Map 0's exit)
scenes.set_up: Open floor or a yard. One person per take (the game puts each character in their place in the group).

shots.camera: 3 m behind you, 1.4 m high (the camera looks over your shoulders at the barn doors).
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing away from the phone (the great doors are ahead of you).

action.any: Stand ready, weapon low (a broom as the rifle). At about 2 s the barred doors in front of you fall outward: flinch, step half a pace back, then lift your head and look out at the snow.

shots.props: A broom or stick as the gun.

shots.camera: Low (0.5 m) in front of you, 6.5 m away from the start X; walk toward it.
shots.marks: Start X; a second tape 4.2 m straight ahead (toward the phone). Face the phone.

action.any: Walk out over the fallen doors toward the phone, slowly (4.2 m in 4 s: a careful step, looking down at the planks for the first two steps, then up and ahead). Stop at the second tape.

shots.props: The broom as the gun, a few planks or a rug on the floor for the first two steps.

shots.camera: 5 m to the side of your path, 1.2 m high; you walk across in front of it.
shots.marks: A start X and an end tape 7 m along a line across the phone's view. Face the end tape.

action.any: Walk the line at an easy pace (7 m in about 6.5 s), looking around at the crossroads as the sun comes up.

shots.camera: 5 m to the side of your path, 1.2 m high.
shots.marks: As shot 3: walk across the phone's view.

action.any: Walk a little faster (1.3 m/s, a steady march), head down against the cold.

scenes.title: Leaving Kaltenbrunn for Totenhafen (the campaign's Kaltenbrunn ending)
scenes.set_up: Open floor or a yard. One person per take.

shots.camera: 3 m in front of you, 1.5 m high (a lantern hangs between you and the phone).
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone (the north wall and its beacon are where the phone is).

action.any: Tired, standing at the beacon. Look up at the gate as its winch grinds (a slow lift of the head), shoulder the gun at 3 s, glance at the person next to you.

shots.camera: Low (0.5 m), 8 m from the start X; you walk toward it.
shots.marks: Start X; a second tape 6 m ahead toward the phone. Face the phone.

action.any: Walk out through the gate toward the phone at 1.2 m/s (6 m in 5 s), tired, looking past the phone at the dawn. Stop at the tape.

shots.camera: 4 m to the side of your path, 1.3 m high.
shots.marks: Walk across the phone's view along a 9 m line.

action.any: Walk on at 1.2 m/s. Halfway, look back over your shoulder at the mine for a second.

shots.camera: 6 m to the side, 2 m high (on a chair).
shots.marks: Walk across the phone's view.

action.any: Keep walking, 1.2 m/s, eyes on the road.

scenes.title: Requiem for Kaltenbrunn: the egg's ending (Kaltenbrunn, the Heart's pit)
scenes.set_up: Open floor. The Heart hangs above and in front of you, about 7 m up: put a chair or a lamp 3 m in front of you as the eyeline and look up past it.

shots.camera: 4 m in front of you, low (0.4 m), looking up.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone (the Heart is above the phone).

action.any: Look up at the Heart, slow, almost reverent; lower your gun. A rumble at the start: steady yourself.

shots.camera: 1.5 m in front of your face, 1.5 m high (a close-up).
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone.

action.any: The Heart has just collapsed: the lights go out one by one around you. Flinch at the flash, then turn your head slowly, following the lights going out from your right to your left.

shots.camera: 3.5 m from you, chest high; the camera circles, but you film it with the phone still.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone.

action.any: Around you the dead fall where they stand. Lower your gun. Look at the bodies on the floor around you, one, then another. Breathe out. One of you (Deacon) takes off his cap at 5 s; the others just stand.

shots.props: The broom as the gun; a cap (Deacon).

shots.camera: 3 m in front of you, then the camera rises (film it still, 1.5 m high).
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone.

action.any: Still standing at the pit. Reinholt's voice on the radio: Peg touches her ear (the radio), the others turn their heads toward her and listen. On Fasbender's line (from 5.5 s) everyone looks up and away to the north.

scenes.title: Leaving Totenhafen for Fernflug (Werk Thalbach)
scenes.set_up: Open floor. A board or a door at chest height 0.6 m in front of you (the transfer board).

shots.camera: 2 m behind the board, 1.4 m high, looking at you over it.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone, the board between you.

action.any: Read the transfer board under a lamp: lean in, follow a line with your finger, then straighten and look at the others (left, right).

shots.props: A board or a sheet of paper on a box at chest height.

scenes.title: Fernflug Act I to II: boarding der Kranich
scenes.set_up: Open floor. The wing's belly and the ramp are ahead of you.

shots.camera: 3 m behind you, low (0.5 m), looking up past you.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing away from the phone (the ramp is ahead).

action.any: At the foot of the ramp: look up at the huge wing over you (a slow tilt of the head), hitch your pack higher on your shoulders, then take the first step toward the ramp at 5 s.

shots.props: A backpack, the broom as the gun.

scenes.title: Fernflug Act II to III: der Kranich comes down at Groom Lake
scenes.set_up: Open floor. Everyone stands; the floor is shaking (you sway it).

shots.camera: 3 m in front of you, 1.4 m high.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone, feet apart.

action.deacon: At the controls: both hands forward at chest height on an imaginary yoke, pulling gently; say the line at 0.7 s, softly, to the aircraft.
action.any: Braced, one hand up on an overhead strap (a broom held high), swaying with the airframe; look ahead at Deacon.

shots.props: A broom held overhead as the strap.

shots.camera: 2.5 m in front of you, 1.4 m high.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone.

action.peg: Braced against the cabin wall (to your left), one hand flat on it, the other on the strap; at 0.9 s say the line to the others, almost cheerful.
action.any: Braced, both hands on the strap, knees bent, looking down (the ground is coming).

scenes.title: KUENDIGUNG: the canon ending (Fernflug Act IV)
scenes.set_up: A table at waist height with a key in a lock (a box with a door key in it) 0.5 m in front of you for the key shot; open floor for the yard shots.

shots.camera: 1.8 m across the table from you, 1.5 m high.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the table and the phone. Jakub stands on your left, half a step back.

action.any: You are the one who turns the key: put your hand on it, hold a breath, say your cancel line, and turn it at 2.2 s (a hard quarter turn). Then stand with your hand still on it, looking up at the others.
action.jakub: Stand at their side; at 2 s put your hand on the table beside theirs. At 4.0 s say 'Do it.' quietly, looking at them.

shots.camera: 3 m behind you, low (0.6 m), looking up past you.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing away from the phone.

action.any: Look up at the Earth in the sky, high in front of you. Don't move much: one of you puts a hand on the next one's shoulder.

shots.camera: 4 m in front of you, low (0.6 m).
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing the phone (the Earth is behind the phone, up).

action.wren: Count under your breath, then at 0 s say the line, looking up at the Earth; on 'and one' lower your eyes.
action.dutch: At 5.0 s say the line to the others, turn your head to them, and nod toward home (over your right shoulder).
action.any: Stand together, look up at the Earth. On Dutch's line (5 s) turn your head to him.

shots.camera: 5 m behind you, 1 m high.
shots.marks: Stand on the X facing away from the phone.

action.any: Stand and look up at the Earth for the whole take. Breathe. Shift your weight once or twice.

not_filmed.why: optional rows above: the squad is small in frame; the stand-in walk stays if you skip them.
camera on the U-boat and the sea; the squad is never directed into frame.
the rocket launch: Dee and Jakub are seen in passing, not directed.
the history scenes become archive reels (UPDATE 12 section 3).
